headline: Saudi Arabia restarts East-West oil pipeline, sources say
summary: Saudi Arabia has restarted its East-West Pipeline and could resume exports from the Red Sea port of Yanbu the same day, three sources said. Signs of rising Middle Eastern oil flows helped drive selling in global oil markets.
why: The East-West Pipeline carries Saudi crude to the Red Sea, providing an alternative route that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz, so its operation affects global crude supply.

source.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012
